newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Realty increases CarrAmerica stake.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Realty increases CarrAmerica stake.

text.p: Security Capital U.S. Realty said Wednesday it raised its stake in CarrAmerica Realty Corp to 18,193,878 shares, or 42.6 percent of the total outstanding, or about 36.5 percent on a fully diluted basis that includes outstanding redeemable limited partnership units.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the company said it acquired 3,140,257 CarrAmerica common shares between July 25 and Wednesday, including 2,142,857 shares it bought directly from CarrAmerica on Wednesday for $55,714,282, or $26.00 a share as part of a public offering of 5 million shares.
Of the total, 997,400 hares were bought between July 25 and Tuesday at prices ranging from $22.56 and $26.06 a share.
U.S. Realty is a Luxembourg-registered property company whose major shareholder is Security Capital.
